# Artur Pereć

> Artur Pereć makes apps for Mac, Windows and iPhone, and the website that goes with each one. He takes each product the whole way: product design, engineering, website, App Store listing, release notes and support, working with a team of AI coding agents.

This site is his portfolio, in English and Polish. It shows four products, a 22-second film of all four, and a contact form. He also takes on larger IT projects and AI integration for companies, websites, apps, design and courses.

## Pages

- [Portfolio (English)](https://arturperec.github.io/): the four products, the film, an about section and the contact form
- [Portfolio (Polish)](https://arturperec.github.io/pl/): the same page in Polish

## Work

- [Mulembe](https://mulembe-app.github.io/): a calm, native Mac terminal for running Claude Code, Codex and other AI coding agents side by side. macOS app; 14 days free, then $19 once
- [49 - Focus Booster](https://49game.github.io/): a one-minute focus game for iPhone, finding 1 to 49 in order on a shuffled board. Free, in open beta on TestFlight
- [Dozelight](https://dozelight.github.io/): a menu bar app that warms the screen past Night Shift, down to candlelight and pure red. macOS and Windows; 14 days free, then $9.99 once
- [Bieg Niepodległości RUNPOLAND](https://biegniepodleglosci.pl/): the website of a 10 km run through Poznań on Polish Independence Day; custom WordPress theme, content, SEO and UX
